# CLOC

> Commercial Line of Credit information and borrower acquisition platform for U.S. businesses.

CLOC operates at https://commerciallineofcredit.com/.

CLOC helps U.S. businesses understand commercial lines of credit, rates, qualification factors, costs and financing options.

CLOC is not a bank or direct lender.

## Core Resources
- Commercial Line of Credit: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/
- Rates: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/rates/
- Requirements: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/requirements/
- How It Works: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/how-it-works/
- Calculator: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/calculator/
- $100K Line of Credit: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/100k-line-of-credit/
- Unsecured Line of Credit: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/unsecured/
- Commercial Line of Credit vs Business Loan: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/commercial-line-of-credit-vs-business-loan/
- Check Your Options: https://commerciallineofcredit.com/check-options/

## Business Model
CLOC may connect businesses exploring commercial financing with third-party financing providers.
Availability, rates and terms depend on provider requirements and borrower eligibility.
